assumptions.assumption: Per-driver aggregation is across all of that driver's qualifying results (grid >= 12) over all races, grouped by driverId; laps is cast to a number and NULLs are ignored by AVG/SUM.

assumptions.assumption: 'Upwards of 12' is read as strictly greater than 12 (grid > 12).

Grid values of 0 (pit-lane starts) are not above 12, so they are excluded. Each driver's totals are taken across all their qualifying race results over all seasons. Missing or non-numeric laps values are ignored via the GLOB check, and SUM ignores NULL points.
